profiles.name: Thomas Cavanagh Construction Limited
profiles.blurb: Eastern Ontario contractor and aggregates producer — construction, asphalt, concrete, land development and homebuilding — founded in 1953 by Thomas Cavanagh with a single dump truck. More than 1,200 employees across three divisions.
facts: Head office on Highway 7 in Ashton since 1984; a concrete plant operates on Industrial Avenue in Carleton Place.
Rebuilt the historic mill in Almonte as the Enerdu hydroelectric facility, completed 2018.
Founder's $1,000,000 gift to the Carleton Place & District Memorial Hospital named its emergency wing; the Thomas Cavanagh Foundation continues the giving.
